text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp season arrived 
once again this year. Last year, Vodka 
tried to ditch it, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm here, aren't I? Though I'm not 
getting on the bus."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, so you were planning to slack off 
after all~?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That ain't it. Just let me meet you guys 
there. I'll catch up later.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Alright then!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so they're joining halfway through, 
huh. Guess it's just the two of us at 
first then.
(Vrrrroooom...)
(Pshhh)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yo! You're late.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh, Vodka? Why are you here???

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
They were so slow, I ended up passing 'em 
on the way.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: With this brand new thing I just bought!
(VROOM! VRROOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, a motorcycle?! You finally bought 
it~~~?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm done being an air rider now. 
From here on out, I'm tearing it up on 
both track and pavement!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wow, so coolー!

Vodka looking mighty proud of herself. It 
seems she took a step forward in her 
everyday life, not just her races.

Still... can Vodka really ride a 
motorcycle? Just as I was wondering 
that...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right, nobody's looking...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Dad. Thanks for giving me a 
ride on the back of your bike.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gotta keep up appearances after all! 
This'll definitely add some serious polish 
to my rep.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gaaahhh, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
J-Just keep quiet about this for now! I 
promise I'll take training seriously, 
okay? Okay?

I decided to keep quiet about it for a 
while.
